business_summary: Mental Health Technologies Co.,Ltd. provides mental health solution services in Japan. It operates through three segments: Mental Health Solutions Business, Medical Work Shift Business, and Other Businesses. The Mental Health Solutions Business offers cloud-based services under the Industrial Physician Cloud brand, packaging services for industrial physicians and public health nurses with mental health care solutions, including ELPIS, a proprietary cloud service for employee counselling, health management, risk assessment, and administrative support. The Medical Work Shift Business provides staffing and outsourcing services to medical institutions, focusing on the dispatch of nursing assistants and administrative staff to address labor shortages and support efficient medical operations. Other businesses include medical career support, offering recruitment and placement services for doctors, and digital marketing services, such as web development, maintenance, and marketing support for medical societies and general companies. The company is involved in the medical career support business and digital marketing business for medical societies and web marketing support services. It also offers counseling services, management, video content distribution and web services, and risk cloud service under the industrial physician cloud name. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
